title: Uniformly small nonzero flat subsheaves with flat quotient
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Work in $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with tensor-flatness as in [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For a module sheaf $M$ define its size by $|M|=|\coprod_{U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)}M(U)|$, the cardinality of the disjoint union of all its sets of sections. There is an infinite cardinal $\kappa$, depending only on the site and $R$, such that every nonzero flat module sheaf $F$ has a subobject $0\ne P\subseteq F$ with $|P|\le\kappa$, $P$ flat, and the sheaf quotient $F/P$ flat. All sets and cardinals are taken in a fixed universe containing the small site and the section sets of $R$. No enough-points or sectionwise-flatness hypothesis is imposed.
